subject: Final Authorization Mosaic — MAP completion, signature cadence & Day0 standby
content:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@helixretail.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal <legal@helixretail.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance gating & final signature cadence

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the MAP you sent last week. We reviewed with Legal this morning. Two quick items before we commit to a Day0 start: a) confirm the signing authority windows (we have signers in EST and BST), and b) confirm the hard start date can be 2027-05-10 if signatures are in by EOD 2027-05-05.

Can you confirm who will actually sign on Redwood's side (roles/titles) and the DocuSign routing order? Also attaching our internal signature matrix for reference.

Att: helix_signature_matrix.xlsx

—Claire
VP, Partnerships
Helix Retail

----
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@helixretail.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acceptance gating & final signature cadence

Claire —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. High level answers below, and a short action list at the bottom. I'm including Rachel (Legal) and Kimberly (CS/AM) to confirm the routing and start-week sequencing.

1) Signing authority & routing- Redwood signing order (proposed):
   1. Kimberly Park, Sr. AM (commercial acceptance + SOW signoff)
   2. Olga Petrov, Head of Sales Ops (final commercial sign-off)
   3. Legal countersign (Rachel Kim) — we prefer legal to countersign after commercial has accepted
   DocuSign routing will be set to ETA by timezone; we can set parallel signers for the Helix east/west coast approvers if needed.

2) Start date and contingency- If we receive fully executed documents by EOD 2027-05-05 PDT, we can target a Day0 of 2027-05-10. If signatures slip to 2027-05-06/07, we push Day0 to 2027-05-13 to preserve the onboarding cadence.

3) MAP completion checklist (short)
   • Mutual evaluation signoff (engineering & security) — Helix confirmed OK via email yesterday
   • Billing & PO — Helix to provide PO or DocuSign net-30 terms at signing
   • Onboarding kickoff slot reserved: 2027-05-10 to 2027-05-14 (tentative)

Action items:
   • Claire — share final PO and confirm Helix signer emails (we'll map to DocuSign)
   • Kimberly — prepare the acceptance test runbook for Day0 small-batch ramp
   • Rachel — prepare standard countersign clause set and SOC2 evidence link to include in DocuSign package

Attachments: redwood_map_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Olga
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

----
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Claire Barnes <claire@helixretail.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance gating & final signature cadence

Claire / Olga —

I reviewed Helix's signature matrix and matched it against our clause set. We can proceed with the routing Olga suggested. A couple legal notes:

• We need Helix to confirm the person with authority to bind (name + title + email) for the PO and the e-sign; otherwise we'll need an additional approver.
• We'll include the SOC2 artifact bundle link in the DocuSign package — link included below.
• Minor redline on section 6.2 (data retention) was accepted in the last draft; no further changes expected.

SOC2 bundle: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AHelix/soc2

Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 14:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance gating & final signature cadence

Claire —

Thanks for confirming Aaron and Sophie. Kimberly here — I'll own the Day0 acceptance runbook and handoff. High-level plan:

• Day0 morning: small-batch traffic to Helix tenant (smoke + latency checks)
• Day0 afternoon: ramp to steady-state N requests/min target for pilot
• Week-1: close monitoring, daily syncs (15m) with Helix SREs and our infra team

I'll send the acceptance runbook as a short checklist to the DocuSign package so that signatures acknowledge the onboarding slot.

I'll also prepare a fallback 'soft start' plan (limited feature set) in case signatures complete late but you still want an earlier hookup.

—Kimberly
Senior AM, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: helix_signature_matrix.xlsx, redwood_map_v3.pdf, docusign_invite_helix_0891.pdf
